findings.summary: Changelog entry carries placeholder PR number #XXXX, violating CONTRIBUTING (confirmed; CI would also fail on it)
The len() % 2 == 0 half of the new guard has no test, so a regression in it passes CI
Comment sits between the operands of the else-if; a named local would read better
Test comment restates the test name; link the issue or drop it
read_utf16_line splits mid-character on misaligned terminator pairs for later lines (pre-existing, separate PR)

why: Only the placeholder changelog number is blocking, since CONTRIBUTING requires the real PR number and the check confirmed it; the missing parity-half test is optional extra coverage a maintainer would merge without, and the rest are nits or pre-existing.
